title: Genus-2 Height Batch Performance
objective: Batch uncached genus-2 local height recurrences, exact outward logarithms, and proof publication so cold rank-2/rank-4 pairings approach the Phase-7 Magma gate without weakening certificates.

handoff.summary: Extended the reviewed proof-safe batch path with compact closure-owned primitive canonical/pairing payloads, lazy public diagnostic materialization, direct polarization from authenticated balls, and one atomic joint cache publication. Initial-height and finite-correction logarithms now share the exact outward integer atanh batch; finite logarithms and denominators are reused without changing the certified enclosure. The standard local 64-bit fixture improved from about 0.632s to 0.322-0.335s rank 2 and from 1.690s to 0.738-0.776s for the four-vector fixture; warm pairing remains about 18-26ms. This is an honest roughly 2x cold improvement, but it still misses the 0.18/0.50s prototype floors and the Phase-7 <=2x Magma gate.
risks: Cold rank-2/four-vector pairing remains well above the historical resident Magma rows; no competitive claim or new bench-1 receipt is made.
Production integration must add four functions to genus2-kummer-height-production and resolve hyperelliptic-curves-kernels source budget 185106 > 175000 by 10106 bytes.
Only linux-x64 was run locally; production-pack integration must repeat native/dynamic differentials on linux-arm64, windows-x64, and macos-arm64.
next_steps: Obtain an independent proof/correctness audit of exact log rounding, hidden proof publication, cancellation atomicity, and cache provenance before integration.

Extend architecture/native-kernels.json with modular_kummer_height_recurrence_batch, dyadic_kummer_height_recurrence_batch, exact_kummer_small_step_batch, and dyadic_log_interval_batch, then resolve the package byte budget and rerun pnpm architecture:check.

Profile the remaining certified batch tail: current rank-2/four-vector batches take about 0.257/0.620s, while named recurrence/log/oracle stages account for about 0.133/0.309s. Further progress requires reducing theorem/result checks and exact arithmetic inside that tail, or accelerating divisor sums/public Cantor arithmetic; compact publication itself is only about 6/25ms.
Do not request bench-1 until local rank-2/four-vector cold timings approach 0.18/0.50s.
